station_name: Hilliard-East Fork Canal near State line, near Evanston, Wyo.
township_range_section: NW¼ sec. 16, T. 2 N., R. 10 E.
notes: Table 'Monthly and yearly mean discharge, in cubic feet per second'. 9 water years (1942-50) x 12 months = 108 cells, minus the dash for Oct. of water year 1942 = 107 (zeros counted). 'The year' column: 8 yearly means (1942 is a dash), counted only in n_variables. Dates are the water years 1942-50 per the water-year rule although Oct. 1941 is blank. State: the location text says the gage is 'in Utah'; the station name says 'near Evanston, Wyo.' Report's own station number '2.' Other distances: 8 ft upstream from abandoned forest road bridge, 300 ft downstream from new road bridge, three-quarters of a mile downstream from head, 25 miles southeast of Evanston. Canal diverts from East Fork Bear River for irrigation, hence Irrigation.
